records.caption: NYC Mayor Mamdani alongside other city partners launched the Jobs NYC Center at 2 Lafayette Street Monday. The Center helps New Yorkers find and secure jobs with the city. Regular walk-in hours begin Monday, October 5. #nyc #mamdani #jobsearch
records.speech: First up is an item that we at City Hall like to call an E C R J. I'm not talking about an egg and cheese on a roll with jalapenos, though that is incredible. I am talking about an extremely cool and reliable job for many New Yorkers, as you just heard from Commissioner Menino, searching for a role in city government, that opportunity has long sat just out of reach. Today, as we announce the official launch of the Jobs N Y C. Center, we are changing that. Thanks to the hard work of the public servants of the department of Citywide Administrative Services, this space, which had previously been left shuttered and vacant by past administrations, has been transformed into a bustling career center. When New Yorkers walk through the these doors, they will find workshops, trainings, and agency hiring halls alongside job fairs. And beginning on October 5th, any New Yorker will be able to walk in between 10:00am and four PM Monday through Thursday and get help filling out paperwork and applications or connect with agencies that are hiring. And they can do all of those things without even having to make an appointment. So often, New Yorkers looking for work struggle with loneliness and isolation. With this center, the job search will no longer be something that New Yorkers have to contend with alone, but a process where they have the support and the backing they need.
